title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes; version bumps
author: Avery Chen
description:
Motivation: bring the three official SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go) to parity for auth ergonomics, retry behavior, and streaming APIs. This PR unifies defaults, surfaces a single high-level API for streaming responses, and fixes several small ergonomics that caused confusion when migrating between SDKs. It also includes coordinated version bumps and changelog updates for a patch release.

What changed (high-level):
- Auth: moved to a single env-key/constructor pattern across SDKs (REDWOOD_API_KEY / explicit credential object). Clear error messages when credentials are missing.
- Retries: standardized retry policy configuration (max_retries, backoff_factor, retry_on_statuses) with sensible defaults and an escape hatch to provide a custom RetryStrategy.
- Streaming: exported a unified streaming iterator/callback pattern across SDKs so code samples translate 1:1 between languages. Added explicit backpressure behavior docs.
- Parity fixes: brought TypeScript and Go response metadata (request_id, model name, timing) in line with Python. Fixed a bug in Go where partial streaming segments were dropped during reconnect.
- Version bumps: python->0.7.3, typescript->1.4.1, go->0.5.2; changelogs updated.

Migration notes:
- If you relied on the old per-SDK auth env var names, switch to REDWOOD_API_KEY or pass credentials into the client constructor. See examples in README.
- Custom retry behavior must now implement RetryStrategy interface (small shim provided for previous duck-typed configs).

Testing & CI: full unit+integration matrix ran across py/ts/go. Streaming canary harness executed against local runtime and hosted staging, with simulated reconnects.

Links: Linear ENG-1934, internal design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1934/unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming

Checklist:
- [x] Python changes (client, docs, tests)
- [x] TypeScript changes (client, docs, tests)
- [x] Go changes (client, docs, tests)
- [x] Integration tests for streaming reconnects
- [x] Changelog & version bumps

Notes: kept backward-compatible shims for the most common auth patterns; breaking change is unlikely but documented.
